scoring_policy: Grades apply to each row's stated criterion. Source/interface review is distinct from a successful runtime check. Equal support rows are omitted and earn no medal; WinBlaze-only advantages above both competitors are omitted and earn no medals; remaining differing support levels remain medal events. Equal grades do not imply identical implementations.
